hooks.name: Sync Spec to Docs
hooks.description: Automatically syncs completed spec documents (requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md) from .kiro/specs/ to docs/features/ when all tasks in a spec are marked complete.

action.prompt: Check if ALL tasks in the current spec's tasks.md are now marked complete. If yes, copy requirements.md, design.md, and tasks.md from .kiro/specs/{feature-name}/ to docs/features/{feature-name}/, creating the folder if needed. If not all tasks are complete, do nothing.
